storyText: Any quantity from 1 to 99 can be added at once, and any quantity from 1 to 99 can be set for a line
faults.seen: adding or setting a quantity of exactly 99 is refused with 422 "The quantity field must not be greater than 98." (also as an error toast in the shop)

storyText: A quantity below 1 is refused with 422 and "The quantity field must be at least 1."
After a refusal the line keeps the quantity it had
faults.seen: PUT /carts/{id}/product/quantity with quantity 0 answers 200 and the line's quantity becomes 1
a cart with a rental and a non-rental product shows "Discount (10%)" and GET /carts/{id} reports 10

storyText: When a product cannot be added, the shop shows an appropriate message
traps.expected: raised as a question for the owner (which products are limited and what the message is); not reported as a defect
